continuousCampaigns.coverage: Chapters 1–8 with earned funds and normal actions; serialized reload after every action; no cheats or prolonged food shortages.

uiControllerTests.scope: Real API bridge, templates and controllers in Node VM; not a rendered-browser review.

art.setting: Remote wilderness; no neighbouring castles or settlements.

limitations: No browser-rendered layout or screenshot audit performed.
A field patrol waits for player decisions; it is not unattended automatic combat.
Spell support is restricted to prepared water, fire, ice, lightning, radiant and healing spells.
The full historical Python suite was not rerun; targeted regressions and full Chapter 1–8 routes were used.
